body:
Strands bead removes the public 2-arg phenomenology. I have not edited InterviewSuite (your reservation). Please apply this compile hunk when you can, or authorize me to include it:

  val once = ProfileScoring.phenomenology(Vector(a1, a2), None, 1)
  val twice = ProfileScoring.phenomenology(Vector(a1, a2, a1, a2), None, 1)
  assertEquals(ProfileScoring.phenomenology(Vector.empty, None, 0).firstPersonRate.isObserved, false)

Until then I keep a private[interview] 2-arg bridge so your suite still compiles. Delete the bridge after your hunk.
